en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a rural landscape with rolling hills, forested areas, traditional houses, and a church with a baroque-style steeple. In the distance, there is a notable building on a hill, possibly a religious or historical site. The image has a nostalgic, early-to-mid-20th-century aesthetic. The bottom left of the postcard contains handwritten-style text.
